The '''ID-75 Heavy Mining Droid''' was a model of [[mining droid]] that was created by the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Ayor-v9]], who used them on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]] and considered his [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to be his "family."<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ID-75 Heavy Mining Droid appears a type of enemy in the Bounty Hunter class mission "Digging His Own Grave" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
